about: Tortuga household catalog. Grades are Tortuga’s own, inspired by the published Bobby Approved ingredient standards (https://www.shopflavcity.com/pages/bobby-approved-app) and shown on an Olive-style meter. Not an official Bobby Approved score, badge, or certification, and not affiliated with FlavCity, Olive, or Seed Oil Scout. Ingredient lists are copied from the cited source. How to add a product: README.md.
standard: Published “10 Commandments of Bobby Approved Ingredients” at https://www.shopflavcity.com/pages/bobby-approved-app. Tortuga checks the label for fragrance, harmful preservatives, artificial colors, optical brighteners, seed oils, and flavors. Pass means a score of 45 or more. We do not use the Bobby Approved app or its database.
source: Open Beauty Facts and Open Products Facts (Open Database License). Each product links to the page its ingredient list was copied from.
